# slr_hello (Resource)

Generates a greeting message `Hello <name>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "slr_hello" "default" {}

resource "slr_hello" "dela" {
  name = "Dela"
}

output "hello_dela" {
  value = slr_hello.dela.message
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Name to greet. Defaults to `World`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier (UUID) of the resource.
- `message` (String) Generated greeting message.
